Hello, Fediverse!

We're Colitu, an open-source VPN project focused on privacy, security, and reliable connectivity in challenging network environments.

We believe privacy tools should be transparent, accessible, and built with the community.

Here, we'll share engineering updates, technical decisions, development progress, and discussions about internet freedom.

Built for networks that fight back.

https://colitu.com
